name: "The Pessimist" by Daou
serverNotes:
🍇 ABOUT: Bold Paso Robles Cabernet blend from DAOU. Highly rated JD 92 pts! Cult favorite 'The Pessimist' - great value premium Cab.

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Cabernet Blend | Dark fruit, chocolate & spice | Well-structured, smooth tannins | Crowd-pleasing Paso style.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Steaks, lamb, hearty pasta, BBQ, bold dishes.

💡 BY THE GLASS: Bold California Cab at an amazing price point. Perfect for steak night!

name: Grand Enclos du Château de Cérons
pronunciation: grahn ahn-KLOH doo shah-TOH duh say-ROHN
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: Red Bordeaux from the Graves, on the Left Bank south of the city. A classic Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot blend with some bottle age.

🍷 STYLE: Medium to full-bodied Bordeaux blend | Blackcurrant, cedar, graphite & dried herbs | Firm, polished tannins | Savory Old World finish

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Filet mignon, surf & turf, veal chop, short rib, aged cheeses.

💡 BY THE GLASS: Pour it for guests who want this style without committing to a bottle.

name: Greenwing Cabernet by Duckhorn
serverNotes:
🌲 📖 ABOUT: Full-bodied Washington Cabernet from the renowned Duckhorn family, Columbia Valley. Pacific Northwest Cab at its best!

🍷 STYLE: Smooth Cabernet | Dark berry, mocha & spice | Accessible with supple tannins | Washington elegance.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Beef, pork, aged cheese, grilled meats, hearty dishes.

💡 BY THE GLASS: Legendary Duckhorn quality from Washington State. Smooth and food-friendly!

name: Cakebread "Mullan Road"
serverNotes:
🎯 📖 ABOUT: Full-bodied red blend from legendary Cakebread Cellars, Washington. World-class winemaking!

🍷 STYLE: Velvety Red Blend | Black fruit, espresso & spice | Velvety texture, integrated tannins | Premium Washington.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Beef tenderloin, short ribs, lamb, rich dishes.

💡 BY THE GLASS: Iconic Napa winery's Washington project. Exceptional quality and value!

name: Robert Mondavi
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon from Robert Mondavi Winery in Oakville, one of the founding names of modern Napa.

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Napa Cabernet | Black cherry, cassis, mocha & toasted oak | Ripe, rounded tannins | Long, polished finish

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Filet mignon, surf & turf, short rib, veal chop, Italian Meat & Cheese Board.

💡 BY THE GLASS: Pour it for guests who want this style without committing to a bottle.

name: Austin Hope Cabernet
serverNotes:
🔥 📖 ABOUT: Bold Paso Cabernet from Austin Hope. Cult favorite from Central Coast! Impressive by-the-glass selection.

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied & Opulent | Jammy black fruit, vanilla & chocolate | Rich style, big tannins | Paso power.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Ribeye, BBQ, bold flavored dishes, grilled meats, rich sauces.

💡 BY THE GLASS: Big, bold Paso Cab that's become a cult sensation. Perfect for meat lovers!

name: Knight's Bridge Meritage
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (knightsbridgewinery.com) Meritage blend from Knights Bridge in Napa. Bordeaux-style blend with Napa power. Premium quality!

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Meritage | Dark fruit, chocolate & spice | Structured, complex | Bordeaux meets Napa.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Prime cuts, lamb, aged cheese.

💡 BY THE GLASS: Napa Meritage from quality producer. Bordeaux-style excellence!
